WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebate_baseline
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
grouped_rebates AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    o.ordertune,
    AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebate,
    AVG(CASE WHEN f.feerate > 0 THEN (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / CAST(f.feerate AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune
)
SELECT 
  gr.orderslink,
  gr.ordertune,
  gr.avg_rebate,
  gr.avg_relative_gap,
  gr.avg_rebate - b.avg_rebate_baseline as excess_rebate
FROM grouped_rebates gr
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE gr.avg_rebate > b.avg_rebate_baseline
ORDER BY excess_rebate DESC
LIMIT 10
